text:
hana: Quick follow-up from the multi-region sync: ops wants a machine-evaluable definition for auto-switchback that respects residency constraints. Short and concrete please.

jorge: Two orthogonal gates: safety (no split-brain risk) and policy (residency/legal). both must pass for auto.

leila: For safety we can emit these per-tenant metrics: runtime_last_applied_seq{tenant,region}, runtime_inflight_leases{tenant,region}, runtime_ingress_queue_len{tenant,region}, server_time_drift_ms{region_pair}. thresholds: seq_delta<=1 for 60s, inflight==0, ingress_queue==0, drift<500ms.

nate: For policy gate control plane should expose tenant.residency_mode in {hard,preferred,none} and tenant.allow_cross_region_writes boolean. if residency_mode==hard and candidate is non-resident -> block auto-switchback.

hana: Can we produce a single composite metric? ops prefers that for alerts.

jorge: Yes: region_switchback_eligible{tenant,region}=1/0 plus reason label (caught_up, policy_block, inflight, drift, operator_lock). emit counters switchback.attempts and switchback.fail_reasons too.

leila: Runbook snippet (minimal):
1) check tenant.residency_mode and allow_cross_region_writes
2) verify region_switchback_eligible==1 for >=60s
3) confirm runtime_inflight_leases==0 and ingress_queue_len==0
4) run deterministic canary (3 idempotent read/writes)
5) flip primary and set tenant.switchback_cooldown_until = now + 30m
6) monitor error rate and tail latency for 10m

nate: CLI override for enterprise (requires audit):
```bash
redwoodctl tenant switchback --tenant acme-corp --target-region eu-west-1 --force --reason "legal-approved-emergency"
```
--force only for support-admin role.

hana: Edge cases: tenants with nondeterministic side-effects should have tenant.requires_deterministic_replay=true and auto-switchback disabled. also, if caught_up not reached in 10m, mark for manual review and keep standby for 1h.

jorge: Next steps: runtime to expose metrics, control plane to add flags + cooldown, ops to update runbook and add CLI snippet, SRE to create dashboard heatmap of seq_delta over time. canary target: small PLG tenant next week.

sre-bot: notice: failover observed tenant=acme-corp at 2026-03-20T11:02:10Z, duration=14m, seq_delta=3, residency_mode=preferred, region_switchback_eligible=0 reason=inflight

hana: thanks all. i'll write a short doc and own runbook PR.
